groups.passageText: M: The client moved tomorrow’s meeting from ten to eleven thirty. W: That works, but Conference Room A is booked then. M: I’ll reserve Room C instead.

questions.explanation: The meeting moved from 10:00 to 11:30.

questions.text: What problem does the woman mention?
questions.explanation: She says Room A is booked.

questions.text: What will the man probably do?
questions.explanation: He says he will reserve Room C.

groups.passageText: W: I can’t access the shared budget file. M: I forgot to update the permissions after moving it to the new folder. W: Could you send me the new link once it’s fixed? M: Sure.

questions.text: What problem does the woman have?
questions.explanation: She cannot access the shared budget file.

questions.text: What did the man forget to do?
questions.explanation: He says he forgot to update permissions.
She asks him to send the new link.

groups.passageText: M: Has the supplier confirmed Friday’s delivery? W: Yes, but only 60 chairs will arrive Friday. The remaining 40 will come Monday. M: Then I’ll tell the event team to use the chairs we already have in storage.

questions.explanation: They discuss delivery of chairs.

questions.text: How many chairs will arrive Monday?
questions.explanation: The woman says the remaining 40 will come Monday.
He plans to use existing chairs from storage.

groups.passageText: W: I’m calling about my order. The tracking page says it was delivered, but I haven’t received it. M: I’m sorry about that. Let me check the delivery photo and contact the courier. W: Thank you. I’ll stay by my phone.

options: She needs a refund for a class
She wants to place an order
questions.explanation: The tracking says delivered, but she has not received it.

questions.text: What will the man do first?
questions.explanation: He says he will check the delivery photo and contact the courier.
She says she will stay by her phone, implying she expects follow-up.

groups.passageText: M: Are you attending the software workshop next week? W: I wanted to, but Tuesday is fully booked. There are still seats on Thursday. M: Thursday works for me too. Let’s ask our manager before we register.

questions.text: Why can’t the woman attend Tuesday?
questions.explanation: She says Tuesday is fully booked.

questions.text: What do the speakers plan to do?
questions.explanation: They will ask their manager before registering.
The woman states seats are still available Thursday.

groups.passageText: W: The hotel sent the final invoice, but breakfast was charged twice. M: I’ll call the billing desk. Do you still have the receipt from checkout? W: Yes, I scanned it and saved it with the travel documents.

questions.explanation: The woman says breakfast was charged twice.

questions.text: What does the man plan to do?
options: Ask for a new receipt from the airline
questions.explanation: He says he will call billing.
She saved a scanned receipt.

groups.passageText: M: We need a larger room for Friday’s product demonstration. W: The auditorium is free after one, but the projector there is being repaired. M: I can bring the portable projector from our department.

questions.explanation: The man says they need a larger room.

questions.text: What problem does the woman mention?
options: The auditorium is occupied all day
The auditorium projector is being repaired
questions.explanation: The projector is under repair.

questions.text: How does the man propose solving the problem?
questions.explanation: He offers to bring a portable projector.

groups.passageText: W: Have you finished the monthly sales charts? M: Almost. I’m waiting for the online-store figures. W: Those were uploaded this morning. Check the folder called September Final. M: Great, then I can finish before lunch.

questions.explanation: The woman asks about monthly sales charts.

questions.text: What information was the man waiting for?
questions.explanation: He says he was waiting for online-store figures.

questions.text: What will the man probably do next?
questions.explanation: He now knows where the figures are stored.

groups.passageText: M: The café downstairs is closed for renovation. W: I saw that. There’s a food truck outside the east entrance today. M: Perfect. I only have twenty minutes before my next call.

questions.explanation: The café is closed for renovation.

questions.text: What does the woman suggest indirectly?
questions.explanation: She mentions a food truck as an alternative.

questions.text: Why is the man in a hurry?
options: He has a train to catch
questions.explanation: He has twenty minutes before his next call.

groups.passageText: W: I’d like to exchange this jacket. M: Of course. Do you need a different size or color? W: A smaller size, if possible. M: Let me check our stock in the back.

questions.text: What does the woman want to do?
questions.explanation: She asks to exchange the jacket.
She asks for a smaller size.
He says he will check stock.

groups.passageText: M: The interview candidate arrived early. W: Great. I’m finishing another call. Could you ask her to complete the visitor form while she waits? M: Sure, and I’ll offer her some water.

questions.explanation: They refer to an interview candidate.

questions.text: Why can’t the woman meet her immediately?
options: She is out of the office
questions.explanation: The woman is finishing another call.

questions.text: What will the man ask the visitor to do?
questions.explanation: He will ask her to complete the visitor form.

groups.passageText: W: The marketing team wants feedback on these two poster designs. M: I prefer the second one because the event date is easier to see. W: I agree, but we should make the website address larger too.

questions.explanation: They discuss two poster designs.

questions.text: Why does the man prefer the second design?
questions.explanation: He says the event date is easier to see.

questions.text: What change does the woman suggest?
questions.explanation: She says the website address should be larger.

groups.passageText: M: I booked the 3:15 train, but the client just asked whether we can stay until four. W: There’s a 5:30 train with plenty of seats. M: Okay, I’ll change my ticket and extend the meeting.

questions.text: What problem does the man have?
options: His train leaves before the client wants the meeting to end
questions.explanation: The original train conflicts with the requested meeting time.

questions.text: What information does the woman provide?
questions.explanation: She says a 5:30 train has plenty of seats.
He says he will change the ticket.

groups.passageText: Attention shoppers. The store will close at seven this evening for a scheduled electrical inspection. Customers with items on hold should collect them before six thirty. Regular hours will resume tomorrow morning at nine.

questions.text: Why will the store close early?
questions.explanation: The announcement cites a scheduled electrical inspection.
Items on hold should be collected before 6:30.
The store resumes regular hours at nine tomorrow.

groups.passageText: Hello, this is Daniel from Northside Dental Clinic calling for Ms. Lewis. I’m confirming your appointment for Tuesday at 2:45 P.M. If you need to change the time, please call us before noon on Monday so we can offer the appointment to another patient.

questions.explanation: He explicitly says he is confirming an appointment.
The stated appointment time is Tuesday at 2:45.

questions.text: What should Ms. Lewis do to change the time?
questions.explanation: She must call before noon Monday.

groups.passageText: Welcome to the City History Museum. Guided tours begin every hour from ten until four. Today, the second-floor photography gallery is closed while a new exhibition is installed. The café and gift shop remain open as usual on the ground floor.

questions.text: What is the talk mainly about?
questions.explanation: The announcement gives museum visitor information.
The second-floor photography gallery is closed.

questions.text: Where are the café and gift shop?
questions.explanation: They are on the ground floor.

groups.passageText: Good morning, everyone. Before today’s safety training begins, please sign the attendance sheet at the front of the room. The first session will cover emergency exits, followed by a short break at ten thirty. The equipment demonstration will take place after the break.

questions.text: What are listeners asked to do first?
questions.explanation: They are asked to sign before training begins.

questions.text: What will the first session cover?
questions.explanation: The first session covers emergency exits.
The equipment demonstration follows the break.

groups.passageText: Due to road construction on Pine Street, Bus 42 will use Oak Avenue between Central Station and City Hall through Friday. The bus will not stop at Pine Street Library during this period. Passengers for the library should get off at Market Square and walk two blocks east.

questions.text: Why is Bus 42 changing its route?
questions.explanation: The announcement states road construction.

questions.text: Which stop will not be served?
questions.explanation: The bus will not stop at the library.
They should get off at Market Square and walk east.

groups.passageText: This month, our company is introducing a new online expense system. Starting Monday, employees should upload receipts directly through the finance portal instead of emailing them. A short video tutorial is available on the staff website, and the finance team will hold two question-and-answer sessions next week.

questions.explanation: The company is introducing an online expense system.
They should upload receipts rather than email them.
The talk mentions a video tutorial and two Q&A sessions.

groups.passageText: Thank you for choosing Harbor Hotel. Breakfast is served on the first floor from six thirty to ten each morning. Guests who need to leave before six thirty can request a takeaway breakfast at reception by nine P.M. the previous evening. Checkout time is eleven A.M.

questions.explanation: Breakfast is served on the first floor.
They can request takeaway breakfast at reception by 9 P.M. the previous evening.
Checkout is at eleven A.M.

groups.passageText: The Lakeside Business Expo opens this Friday at the Convention Center. Online registration closes Thursday at noon, but visitors may still register at the entrance for a slightly higher fee. Parking is limited, so organizers recommend using the subway, which stops directly across from the center.

questions.explanation: Online registration closes Thursday at noon.

questions.text: What is true about registering at the entrance?
questions.explanation: Door registration is available for a higher fee.
Organizers recommend the subway because parking is limited.

groups.passageText: Hi, team. I’ve reviewed the first draft of the customer survey. The questions are clear, but the survey is currently too long. Please reduce it from twenty-five questions to about fifteen and add one optional comment box at the end. I’d like the revised version by Wednesday afternoon.

questions.explanation: The speaker reviewed a customer survey draft.
The speaker asks to reduce 25 questions to about 15.
The deadline is Wednesday afternoon.

groups.passageText: Passengers traveling on Flight 605 to Seoul: boarding will begin shortly at Gate 18. Because the flight is full, passengers with large carry-on bags may check them at the gate free of charge. Families traveling with young children will be invited to board first.

questions.explanation: Boarding is at Gate 18.

questions.text: Why may passengers check large carry-on bags?
questions.explanation: The announcement says the flight is full.
Families with young children receive priority boarding.
